Metadata.description: Langganin helps you track subscriptions & free trials, reminds you before auto-renewals hit, and sums up your monthly spending.

Landing.heroHeadline: Stop surprise charges. Track all your subscriptions & trials in one place.
Landing.heroSubheadline: Langganin helps you monitor auto-renewal dates, sends reminders before you get charged, and sums up your monthly spending. All in Rupiah.
Landing.feature1Desc: Netflix, Spotify, ChatGPT, Shopee VIP, and all your free trials — save names, prices, billing cycles, and payment methods in one place.
Landing.feature2Desc: Email 3 days and 1 day before auto-renewal or trial expiration. WhatsApp coming soon — because that's what you actually check.
Landing.feature3Desc: Monthly & yearly totals, category breakdown chart, and this week's upcoming renewals — all visible the moment you open the app.
Landing.feature4Desc: A calendar view with colour-coded category markers — instantly spot which dates are busy and need your attention.
Landing.indonesiaDesc: GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, QRIS. Your payment methods aren't just a generic e-wallet label. WhatsApp, not just email. Rupiah and Bahasa Indonesia as the default experience, not an afterthought. Not just another subscription tracker. This one is built for how you pay, how you track, and how you remember.

Login.title: Log in
Login.description: The Supabase Auth login form (email & password, plus Google OAuth) will live on this page.

Register.title: Sign up
Register.description: The Supabase Auth registration form will live on this page — a new account also sets up default categories for first-time users.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Your monthly & yearly (projected) spending summary, renewals due in the next 7 and 30 days, and a spending-by-category chart will show up here.
Dashboard.noSubscriptions: No subscriptions yet! Start tracking your first one.

Subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
Subscriptions.description: All your subscriptions — with search, category & status filters, and an add-subscription button — will live on this page.

SubscriptionDetail.title: Subscription Detail
SubscriptionDetail.description: The full edit form (name, category, price, billing cycle, trial, payment method, notes), event history, and a delete action for this subscription will show up here.

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.description: A monthly calendar view marking renewal and trial-end dates (colored by category) will live on this page.

Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.description: Spending trends over time, category breakdowns, and call-outs for your priciest subscriptions will land on this page (Phase 3).

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Profile (default currency, timezone, monthly budget cap), custom categories with colors, and notification preferences will be managed on this page.
